question:
DRAG DROP -
An engineer must authenticate EIGRP configuration on interface Eth1/1 of the Cisco Nexus 9000 Series Switch. Drag and drop the CLI commands from the right to complete the EIGRP key authentication configuration on the left. Not all CLI commands are used.
template:
interface Ethernet1/1
  ip router eigrp
  ip authentication key-chain {{1}} NXOS {{2}}
  ip authentication mode eigrp {{3}} md5
!
{{4}} EIGRP
  key 1
    {{5}} CISCO
!
router eigrp NXOS
  autonomous-system 12
  authentication {{6}} md5
theory: NX-OS keychain management provides the shared-secret mechanism (with configurable send/accept lifetimes) that routing-protocol authentication relies on. Applying it to EIGRP requires tying the interface to a defined key chain (ip authentication key-chain eigrp <process> <chain-name>) and enabling key-based authentication mode on the interface, while the key chain itself (defined globally with 'key chain', a key ID, and a key-string holding the shared secret) supplies the actual credential, and the EIGRP process is separately configured for MD5 authentication mode. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 18 - Keychain Authentication, applied to NX-OS EIGRP)
